title: Last and First Men — voice
excerpt:
Before closing this preface I would remind the reader that throughout
the following pages the speaker, the first person singular, is supposed
to be, not the actual writer, but an individual living in the extremely
distant future.
limitation: 真实作者明确区分正文说话人与实际作者。 本条只证明归属/方法边界，不证明未来情节的现实成败。

title: Last and First Men — purpose
excerpt:
Not that we should seek actually to prophesy what will as a
matter of fact occur; for in our present state such prophecy is
certainly futile, save in the simplest matters. We are not set up as
historians attempting to look ahead instead of backwards. We can only
select a certain thread out of the tangle of many equally valid
possibilities.
limitation: 作者否认就具体事件作真实预言，选择的是许多可能线索之一；不等于所有小说都无预测。 本条只证明归属/方法边界，不证明未来情节的现实成败。

title: Last and First Men — counter
excerpt:
The actual writer thinks he is merely contriving a work of fiction.
Though he seeks to tell a plausible story, he neither believes it
himself, nor expects others to believe it. Yet the story is true.
limitation: 引言中叙述者自称故事为真，构成须考虑的相反表象；同句仍说实际作者自己不信，不能将角色真实性断言偷换成作者背书。 本条只证明归属/方法边界，不证明未来情节的现实成败。

title: Last and First Men — aesthetic
excerpt:
I have imagined for aesthetic purposes
that our race will destroy itself. There is today a very earnest
movement for peace and international unity; and surely with good fortune
and intelligent management it may triumph. Most earnestly we must hope
that it will. But I have figured things out in this book in such a
manner that this great movement fails.
limitation: 作者明确区分审美设置的毁灭线索和现实中和平运动可能成功的判断。后者在序言，按METHOD序言不抽取，不因体裁排除正文。 本条只证明归属/方法边界，不证明未来情节的现实成败。
